# Paths exempt from the large-blob guard (scripts/check-large-blobs.sh).
#
# One glob per line, matched against the blob's path with bash `==`.
# Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored.
#
# Only add a path here when the file genuinely belongs in git history, and say
# why in the PR description. Build outputs, downloaded tool binaries, wheels and
# archives do NOT belong here -- install them in the workflow instead
# (722-ci.yml already `go install`s actionlint rather than committing it).

# Pre-existing WHMCS theme bundle: three assets over 1 MiB (fa-light-300.svg,
# fa-regular-400.svg, js/scripts.js). Already on main, so the range scan skips
# them; listed so that a legitimate theme refresh is not blocked.
whmcs/theme/six_ffc/*
whmcs/theme/six_ffc/**

# docs/lessons-ledger.md: the durable lessons record. AGENTS.md requires a row
# in the same PR as any fix that surprised somebody, so this file grows on a
# large share of PRs and can only ever get bigger. It crossed 1 MiB on #1224
# (main was 1041982 bytes, ~6.6 KiB of headroom, and three new rows crossed it).
#
# Trimming a row does NOT shrink it -- prettier pads table cells back to the
# column width, measured: halving one cell left the row byte-identical in
# length. Only deleting rows would help, and deleting lessons is the one thing
# this file exists to prevent. Splitting or archiving the ledger is the real
# fix and is tracked separately; this entry keeps the guard useful for the
# binaries it was written for instead of blocking every ledger PR.
docs/lessons-ledger.md
